name: Summer Picture ~Chiisana Oka no Chiisana Yume~
original_name: サマーピクチャー～小さな丘の小さな夢～
source:
Yumemimachi is a small town that faces the Seto Inland Sea.
The industry of this town, which is in population decline, includes fishing, agriculture, and a hill called Yumemigaoka that serves as a sight-seeing spot.
Yumemimachi is being swallowed up by other expanding towns, and Yumemigaoka is vanishing due to development.
The heroine and her childhood friends unite to somehow protect Yumemigaoka, however...
Now, the story of a small miracle begins.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE050811.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
梦见町是一座面向濑户内海的小镇。

这座人口不断减少的城镇，其产业包括渔业、农业，以及作为观光景点的梦见之丘。

梦见町正被不断扩张的其他城镇吞没，梦见之丘也因开发而逐渐消失。

女主角和儿时玩伴们联合起来，试图保护梦见之丘，但……

一个小小的奇迹故事就此开始。

[来自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE050811.html]DLsite English[/url]]
